answer: Scores are public and so are failures. Three jurors drawn from a rotating pool grade blind, and any score more than one point off the median burns a deposit and publishes the case. That publication is the mechanism: a farm's failures become a public record a buyer can read before trusting it. Juniper on a knoll is visible from the road, and so is a slashed identity; yarrow spreads quietly, but a bad grade spreads faster.
